items.rationale: Glass Breakage Cover is agreed, so the drilling counts as glazing work under 2.7.2 and 1.3. Case 11 showed a low price level for this line, so I assume a small amount.

items.description: Installation of new glass into frame
items.rationale: Setting and fitting the pane is glazing work covered under 2.7.2 now that the optional peril is agreed. I priced it at a modest labour amount in line with Case 11.
The cracked cabinet pane is a glazing element, covered under 2.7.1 as the Glass Breakage Cover is agreed. The made-to-measure replacement is indemnified at ordinary market price, with no betterment.
One attendance is indemnified under 7.1.12 because covered glazing work was done at that visit. Case 11 and Case 3 suggest a small charge.
